suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. Require emphysema followed by separately diagnosed lung cancer; explicitly account for smoking and other carcinogenic exposures. Systematic review supports a population-level emphysema–lung-cancer association, not all respiratory malignancies and not individual causation. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Emphysema and Lung Cancer / Tracheal Cancer / Bronchial Cancer
